authority: Owner directions in the current SHI thread
priority: Complete the playable story first, before high-resolution cinematic polish.
storyGate: Connect the opening, crossing and Chen council with consequences and an earned conclusion, then integrate the authored continuation episode by episode. Rules or prose alone do not count as a complete playable story.

localVideoGenFirstPass.instruction: Use the fastest suitable low-resolution generation first.
localVideoGenFirstPass.purpose: Check shot order, story comprehension, pacing and character continuity with inexpensive preview footage.
localVideoGenFirstPass.settings: Select from the actual installed model's supported fast/low-resolution presets after inspecting LocalVideoGen. Do not invent a resolution or promise an unmeasured runtime.
localVideoGenFirstPass.promotionGate: Generate higher-resolution replacements only after the story and edit work; do not block narrative development on final media.
localVideoGenFirstPass.unchangedConstraints: Verify commercial rights, review every output, preserve consistent character references, avoid paid generation without explicit confirmation, and permit at most one SHI heavy generation/build job at a time.

storyDraftCheckpoint.scope: Chinese authoring draft for acts five through eight: five scenes, sixteen decisions, thirty-one conditional passages and three authored orderly endings. The resource-backed rules separately distinguish a fourth, scattered outcome with its own reaction. Explicit Fan Yang outcomes and companion presence contexts including unestablished whereabouts; not integrated client gameplay.
storyDraftCheckpoint.readExample: node scripts/story-readthrough.mjs --read deferred absent unavailable send-support gather-own hold-formation strip-identities move-with-remnant
storyDraftCheckpoint.boundary: Exhaustive authoring graph checks do not establish resource balance, historical accuracy, human enjoyment or client playability. The draft is excluded from current fixed-path content exports.

continuityCheckpoint.scope: Replays chapter, Chen and Fan Yang snapshots before preparing the retreat story entry. Keeps resource scales separate, preserves earlier orders and rejects unfinished, failed or incompatible prior episodes. Historical cooperation does not establish later physical presence.
continuityCheckpoint.verification: packages/game-core/tests/retreat-entry.test.ts exhausts 993 Fan Yang endings across all Chen routes and all three arrival classes, plus chapter-choice, tamper, failure, revision and legacy-save checks.
continuityCheckpoint.boundary: Caller supplies verified canonical content hashes. No game save is written, no resource is refilled, no actual companion reunion is established and no new client scene is exposed.

rulesCheckpoint.scope: Five scenes with inherited capacity, affordable grain/time costs, visible requirements, conditional shared-ledger and escort-reserve effects, additional provisioning for admitted people, and four endings. Exhausted positions retain a legal exit, not an invented peaceful reunion. Snapshots bind both rules and prose revisions and replay choices instead of trusting saved totals.
rulesCheckpoint.custody: Orderly dispersion assigns remaining provisions to groups; scattering leaves custody unresolved. Neither preserves a duplicate common stockpile.
rulesCheckpoint.focusedVerification: Six rules tests pass. Exhaustive checks traverse 97,065 complete resource-backed routes from 993 prior endings, verify all four outcomes, legal exits, preview/commit agreement, no automatic food/time refill, replay and source-state preservation. This proves finite rules behavior, not fun or presentation quality.
rulesCheckpoint.boundary: Development rules, not a client integration or human balance approval. No resupply route is yet authored for completely exhausted entries; departure or scattering remains possible. Authoring-only readthrough does not apply these resource rules.

currentNextStep: Story first: connect the resource-backed retreat rules and canonical dialogue in a development client, showing exact costs, conditional reactions and the scattered-outcome override before confirmation. Preserve separate durable saves and prior campaign state. Resolve council authority and message/travel chronology, author a costly resupply/recovery opportunity, and establish companion whereabouts through events rather than assumptions.
